entries.title: Pointer-capability case study
entries.question: Verify construction, projection, splitting, casting, and reference reconstruction; include lifetime-extension and aliasing counterexamples.
answered_research_scope: Actual two-field projection/write, returned pair, abstract valid-root/exclusive-write premises and outside-root frame theorem.
unanswered_research_scope: Reference construction/splitting/casting/reconstruction, concrete provenance/lifetimes and Rust alias/lifetime-extension counterexamples.
future_engineering_obligations: Connect permission premises to a Rust resource/lifetime model.

entries.title: Certifying Charon transformations
entries.question: Design pass-level relations and evidence connecting the original imported representation to final LLBC.
answered_research_scope: Actual captured original/postmicro/built/final selected fork descriptors, generic all-state CFG-to-structured relation and actual nop elimination.
unanswered_research_scope: Individual internal micro-pass boundaries; larger imported grammar and semantic capture adequacy.
future_engineering_obligations: Emit and compose per-pass witnesses in the actual producer.

entries.title: Certifying Aeneas functionalization
entries.question: Investigate correspondence evidence for symbolic execution, borrow reconstruction, control-flow joins, and pure-program transformations.
answered_research_scope: Actual simple branch-join correspondence plus emitted choose/pair-update endpoint and returned-state/frame relation.
unanswered_research_scope: General symbolic execution, nested borrow reconstruction, join abstraction and other pure-program passes.
future_engineering_obligations: Integrate selected relation into Aeneas producer/checker interfaces.

entries.title: A small verified Anneal certificate checker
entries.question: Compare a proved executable validator with replay through a general-purpose proof kernel.
answered_research_scope: Proved logical Boolean validator, actual derived native execution and exact kernel replay on the same selected arithmetic property/domain; assumptions, compiler/parser/IO frontier, mutation verdicts and sampled costs compared.
future_engineering_obligations: Native acceptance needs an explicit trusted compiler/runtime/parser bridge policy or a verified bridge theorem.

entries.title: A certificate inventory for every extraction pass
entries.question: Map actual input/output boundaries and required semantic lemmas; this identifies where incremental certification can begin and where gaps remain.
answered_research_scope: Exact observed raw-preset/original-print/postmicro/built/final/serialized/emitted boundaries; distinct configurations and pair entry/unit representation differences retained.
unanswered_research_scope: Inventory and semantic lemmas for every internal pass and larger input families.
future_engineering_obligations: Expose missing intermediate snapshots and pass-specific witness interfaces.

entries.title: Renaming, substitution, and binding
entries.question: Certify variable identities and capture avoidance; apparently administrative transformations can silently alter program meaning.
answered_research_scope: Exact typed local identities, copy/move source/destination modes and stronger state/trace counterexample for moving the wrong same-valued local.
future_engineering_obligations: Extend binder and semantic relation for identity-changing passes.

entries.title: Control-flow reconstruction
entries.question: Connect MIR blocks and jumps to structured conditionals and loops; correctness must account for every exit and exceptional edge.
answered_research_scope: Actual four-block diamond to structured conditional certificate; every edge/return in admitted grammar checked, storage preserved and nop identity proved.
unanswered_research_scope: Loops, exceptional edges, multi-exit joins and general CFG reconstruction.
future_engineering_obligations: Add explicitly modeled edges and nontrivial join witnesses.

entries.title: Local-state elimination and SSA-like transformations
entries.question: Certify tuple-passing, fresh variables, and state updates; generated pure functions must retain dependencies between imperative operations.
answered_research_scope: Imperative selected pair update preserves first-field/input dependencies and temporary state; exact emitted tuple result agrees under entry premises.
unanswered_research_scope: General SSA/fresh-variable/local-state elimination passes and multiple dependent updates.
future_engineering_obligations: Connect actual pass witnesses to a reusable state-elimination relation.

entries.title: Loop-to-recursion translation
entries.question: Compare invariants, recursive equations, fuel, and divergence semantics; bounded execution or accidental termination cannot substitute for the original loop.
answered_research_scope: Acyclic grammar rejects loops and proves all fuel budgets >=3; no bounded-run/source-termination conflation.
unanswered_research_scope: Actual loop-to-recursion certificate, invariant/recursive equation and divergence comparison.
future_engineering_obligations: Implement a distinct loop relation; do not extend this acyclic theorem by labels.

entries.title: Function extraction, closures, and captured environments
entries.question: Certify extracted helpers and closure representations; code movement must preserve captured state, call behavior, and identity where observable.
answered_research_scope: Closed call-free selected-body gates make the current missing-dependency boundary explicit.
unanswered_research_scope: Extracted helpers, closures, captured environments, call behavior and observable identity.
future_engineering_obligations: Add concrete call/capture/dependency closure grammar and certificates.

entries.title: Borrow abstraction and backward functions
entries.question: Establish correspondence for Aeneas-style borrow elimination and returned updates; this is a distinctive semantic obligation rather than ordinary value translation.
answered_research_scope: Actual Aeneas returned pair update and explicit source-place/selected-LLBC/pure-result/heap-frame correspondence under external root/exclusive premises.
unanswered_research_scope: Nested borrows, explicit backward functions, concrete Rust borrow/lifetime adequacy and alias reconstruction.
future_engineering_obligations: Discharge the external permission/capture frontier and compose caller/callee borrow relations.

entries.title: Proof-producing generation of checker implementations
entries.question: Explore deriving executable checkers from verified logical definitions; this connects compilation research directly to Anneal’s internal TCB.
answered_research_scope: Actual executable derivation from a proved logical definition through Lean C plus native backend; theorem versus compiler/runtime/parser/IO trust endpoints and integration costs identified.
future_engineering_obligations: Provide verified code generation if native verdicts are to replace kernel authority without new compiler trust.

entries.title: Certificates for a real Charon pass sequence
entries.question: Use actual intermediate artifacts from one zerocopy example; this tests whether per-pass certification fits the existing pipeline.
answered_research_scope: Actual legacy Charon intermediates and captured pass-sequence certificate on two synthetic safe functions, with precise initial-boundary differences and restrictions.
unanswered_research_scope: Required actual zerocopy example; broader existing-pipeline pass certification.
future_engineering_obligations: Apply the specimen method to an actual supported zerocopy extraction with its dependency/configuration closure.

entries.title: An Aeneas borrow-translation prototype
entries.question: Certify one representative borrow/update transformation; this tests a central semantic feature before extending to raw memory.
answered_research_scope: One actual representative pair borrow/update transformation certified: exact emitted body, imported operation order, independent source-place model, preserved first field/outside heap and caller entry premises; native all-byte controls.
future_engineering_obligations: Prove frontend/capture/resource adequacy and integrate the conditional certificate in the pipeline.

entries.title: A safe-wrapper domain-coverage experiment
entries.question: Use a safe API over unsafe representation operations; demonstrate that certification covers all permitted callers and rejects artificially narrowed models.
unanswered_research_scope: Required safe API over unsafe representation operations and all permitted Rust callers have not been examined. The safe-only pair probe and model gate are not a source guarantee for such an API.
future_engineering_obligations: Acquire and model an actual unsafe-backed safe API before attempting its caller-domain certificate.

entries.title: A generated checker implementation prototype
entries.question: Compare kernel checking with a proof-produced executable checker; measure actual trust reduction alongside performance and integration costs.
answered_research_scope: Actual native checker built from proved Lean logical source versus kernel replay; valid/invalid execution, generated C/tool/binary identities, observed timings and exact remaining compiler/runtime/parser frontier.
unanswered_research_scope: A proof-produced executable/native-code theorem and its actual trust-reduction measurement.
future_engineering_obligations: Use an independently verified code-generation route or explicitly retain compiler/runtime trust.

scope_policy: full identifies a completed bounded research answer with stated frontiers; partial preserves genuinely unanswered question scope. Integration/adequacy implementation obligations are recorded separately. No global tracker completion is authorized by this file.
limits: No actual zerocopy artifact for P128.
No unsafe-backed safe API for P135.
Native checker is derived via unverified compilation, not a proof-produced native binary for P136.
Legacy alpha24 producer uses Lean4.30rc2/Charon0.1.210/rustc1.98nightly; independent certificates/native checker also use Lean4.31. No patched-current-stack continuity claimed.
Operational stage/run logs are evidence, not kernel-certified authenticated provenance.
